Beth Van Duyne

Republican candidate for U.S. Representative, District 24, Dallas County, Texas · Incumbent

U.S. Representative for Texas's 24th Congressional District (incumbent)

Beth Van Duyne is a Republican who has represented Texas's 24th Congressional District in the U.S. House since January 2021. Before Congress she was mayor of Irving, Texas, from 2011 to 2017. She is the Republican nominee seeking a fourth term in the November 3, 2026 general election against Democrat Kevin Burge.

Where Duyne stands

Fraud against seniors
Sponsored H.R. 8883, the Protecting Seniors and Stopping Fraudsters Act, introduced May 19, 2026.
COVID-era unemployment fraud
Sponsored H.R. 8873, the Recover COVID Unemployment Fraud in Banks Act, introduced May 19, 2026.
Taxes
Introduced H.Res. 1383, commemorating the one-year anniversary of the Working Families Tax Cuts law.
Immigration and national security
Introduced H.R. 9447, the Getting Terrorist Fanatics Out Act of 2026.
